expected_level_description: You can: - make sound clinical judgements about the effect of digital services on care - challenge unsafe practice, in digital or clinical settings, with confidence - support other clinicians to apply their professional standards to digital work
You can: - lead clinical engagement for a product or programme - turn clinical needs and evidence into requirements - champion safe adoption among clinical peers

You can: - set design principles and standards for clinical systems across the organisation - lead optimisation programmes that measurably improve care and staff experience - advise senior leaders on clinical system choices and their effect on care

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

You can: - design data models and reference sets using clinical terminologies - map between terminologies and classifications, and explain the limits of a mapping - advise teams on terminology use in products and analytics

skill: Human factors and usability in clinical systems
expected_level_description: You can: - plan and run human factors assessments of clinical systems - turn findings into design changes and clinical safety controls - assess alert burden and the risk of workarounds

You can: - design evaluations and benefits plans for digital health products - choose suitable measures for clinical outcomes, safety, and experience - judge the strength of evidence and explain its limits
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
